_note: This file stands in for what the admin screens would save to the database. Nothing here is hard-coded in the scoring engine; the engine only knows the small menu of scoring methods.

project_constraints.label: Total price within the budget ceiling

licence_holder.instruction: Who holds the Ontario electrical contractor licence (ECRA/ESA) for this work? 'bidder' only if the proposal states the bidding company itself holds it. 'subcontractor' if the electrical work or licence belongs to another company, including one 'to be confirmed'. 'not_stated' if the proposal does not say.

licence_number.instruction: The licence number exactly as written, or null if none is given.

wsib_clearance.instruction: true only if the proposal states the bidder has current WSIB clearance; otherwise false.

liability_insurance_cad.instruction: Amount of liability insurance the bidder states it carries, in CAD, as a plain number (e.g. 5000000). null if not stated.

qualifying_installs_count.instruction: Number of completed commercial solar installations of 100 kW or more that the proposal claims. null if no number is given.

experience_period_stated.instruction: The time period the bidder gives for those installations, copied as written (e.g. 'in the last five years'). null if none.

total_price_cad.instruction: Total proposed price in CAD as a plain number. If the currency is not CAD or the price is split into parts with no total, set null and explain in notes.

price_exclusions.instruction: Anything the proposal says is excluded from the price (e.g. permits, taxes). null if nothing is excluded or nothing is said.

completion_weeks.instruction: Committed completion time in weeks from award. Convert months to weeks only if stated precisely. If the schedule is not committed (e.g. 'to be determined'), set null.

panel_warranty_years.instruction: Panel / manufacturer warranty length in years. null if not stated.

workmanship_warranty_years.instruction: Installer workmanship warranty length in years. null if not stated.

named_project_lead.instruction: true if the proposal commits a named or specifically identified project lead / manager now. false if the lead will be assigned later or is not mentioned.

crew_described.instruction: true if the proposal describes the installation crew (for example its size or certification).

safety_plan.instruction: true if the proposal states it includes a site safety plan.

performance_monitoring.instruction: true if the proposal offers monitoring of the solar system's performance after installation. Project progress reports alone do not count.

criteria.name: Ontario electrical contractor licence
criteria.admin_description: The bidder itself holds the licence and states it in the proposal.

criteria.name: WSIB clearance and $5M liability insurance
criteria.admin_description: Both are confirmed in the proposal.

criteria.name: Relevant experience
criteria.admin_description: Commercial installs of 100 kW or more in the last 5 years.

criteria.name: Price
criteria.admin_description: Lower total cost within the budget ceiling.

criteria.name: Warranty
criteria.admin_description: Length of panel and workmanship warranties.

criteria.name: Team and approach
criteria.admin_description: Named project lead, crew, safety and monitoring plan.
